name: Sunflower
description: Sunflowers (Helianthus annuus) are a cheerful and popular flower that is considered non-toxic and safe for cats. All parts of the sunflower, including the petals, leaves, stem, and seeds, are not poisonous to felines. This makes them a great, worry-free choice for gardens and bouquets in households with curious cats. While sunflowers are safe, it's a good practice to prevent pets from eating large quantities of any plant material. Ingesting a large amount of leaves or petals could potentially lead to mild gastrointestinal upset, such as vomiting or diarrhea. Additionally, the tough, fibrous stalks or sharp hulls of the seeds could present a minor choking risk, but this is not a common concern.
